meetings.label: Morning safety huddle
meetings.focus: Census, capacity, discharges, staffing, safety and throughput constraints.

meetings.label: Morning Plan Ahead
meetings.focus: Surgical volume by operating date, receiving beds, trays, equipment, coverage and anticipated barriers.

meetings.label: Afternoon Plan Ahead
meetings.focus: Changes from the morning, explicit resolutions, late coverage, next-day readiness and actions.

meetings.label: Operations huddle
meetings.focus: Discharges, receiving capacity, PACU holds, staffing and carry-forward concerns.

meetings.label: Evening safety huddle
meetings.focus: Overnight capacity, staffing, safety and concerns that affect the next operating day.
